create_moe_linear_layer: create a Linear mixture of experts layer with N experts mapping input to output features
build_feedforward_moe_network: build a FeedForward mixture of experts network with configurable hidden layers and ReLU activations
create_attention_based_experts: create an AttentionBasedExperts module that uses soft or hard attention to gate expert selection
create_cluster_of_experts: create a ClusterOfExperts module that maps tasks to subsets of experts based on keyword matching
create_ensemble_of_experts: create an EnsembleOfExperts module that activates all experts for every task in the mixture
